$comment: Action animations derived from each sprite's idle frame by scripts/art/build-action-anims.ts (run after the sprite builders): attack (4 frames: wind-up, strike with a smear of the given kind, follow-through, recover), cast (4 frames, glow and rim light in the given colour) and hurt (2 frames: white flash, red flinch). Every frame of these sprites moves to assets/0x72/actors.png; aliases that share the art follow.
